## Norton Guides

The viewer reads **Norton Guides** (`.ng`), the help files of DOS and Clipper
libraries. V or Autoview shows a guide as a document: its title and credits,
its menus, then every entry with a number (`§12`). Links and see-also lines
say which entry they lead to (`→ §12`), so the viewer's search takes you
there. The drawing characters of the guide show as they did in DOS. A guide
that is damaged or made to trick a reader shows what it can, with a list of
the problems at the top. H shows the bytes.

The format is known thanks to Dave Pearson, who worked it out in the 1990s:
https://www.davep.org/norton-guides/
